```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(jsonlite)
library(httr2)
options(HTTPUserAgent = "3MB001-course", timeout = 90)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
use_snapshot <- FALSE
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
retrieved <- if (use_snapshot) "2026-11-18" else as.character(Sys.Date())
get_json <- function(url, ...) {
  req <- req_url_query(request(url), ...)
  resp_body_json(req_perform(req_retry(req, max_tries = 3)), simplifyVector = FALSE)
}
cache_csv <- function(name, fetch) {
  file <- file.path("data", paste0(name, "-", retrieved, ".csv"))
  if (file.exists(file)) return(read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  if (use_snapshot) stop("Missing snapshot: ", file)
  value <- fetch()
  write.csv(value, file, row.names = FALSE)
  value
}
```

# Data

Name the sources, GTEx release, and whether you used live data or a snapshot.

```{r gtex-fetch}
genes <- params$genes
tissues <- c("Skin_Not_Sun_Exposed_Suprapubic", "Esophagus_Mucosa",
             "Muscle_Skeletal", "Heart_Left_Ventricle", "Brain_Cortex",
             "Nerve_Tibial", "Liver", "Lung")
fetch_expression <- function() {
  rows <- lapply(genes, function(gene) {
    ref <- get_json("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/reference/gene",
                    geneId = gene, datasetId = "gtex_v8")$data
    exact <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$geneSymbol, gene), ref)
    if (length(exact) != 1) stop("Ambiguous gene: ", gene)
    id <- exact[[1]]$gencodeId
    exp <- get_json("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianGeneExpression",
                    gencodeId = id, datasetId = "gtex_v8", itemsPerPage = 250)$data
    exp <- Filter(function(x) x$tissueSiteDetailId %in% tissues, exp)
    do.call(rbind, lapply(exp, function(x) data.frame(
      gene = gene, gencode_id = id, tissue = x$tissueSiteDetailId,
      tpm = x$median, dataset = "gtex_v8")))
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
# Parameter-specific live cache avoids reusing results for another gene set.
cache_name <- if (use_snapshot) "gtex-expression" else
  paste0("gtex-expression-", paste(sort(genes), collapse = "_"))
expression <- cache_csv(cache_name, fetch_expression)
if (!all(genes %in% expression$gene)) stop("Requested genes absent from cache")
expression <- expression[expression$gene %in% genes, ]
stopifnot(nrow(expression) == length(genes) * length(tissues))
```
